content: Second, we combine semantic units recursively on the word tree-LSTM in a bottom-up fashion. For leaf nodes, we leverage the Leaf-LSTM (the bottom-left of Figure 2 , explained in section 3.3) to compute $\tilde{\mathbf {c}}_{t}$ and $\tilde{\mathbf {h}}_{t}$ in sequential order, with the corresponding input $\mathbf {x}_t$ .
